results.title: Mom Refuses To Let Daughter Attend Ex-Best Friend’s Funeral After What She Did Years Ago
results.description: Some mistakes can be repaired with time, while others leave damage that no apology can undo. Seven years ago, one woman ruined her best friend’s life and destroyed their relationship. Now that her former friend has passed away, she wants to attend the funeral. Her mother is pleading with her to stay away, worried that her presence could reopen old wounds and cause the grieving family even more pain. But she is refusing to listen.

results.title: ‘Don’t let me die’ –Veteran Nollywood actress solicits financial help for life-saving surgeries
results.description: Veteran Nigerian actress, Ngozi Nwosu, has begged the general public for financial assistance amid a battle with undisclosed illness. The actress made the plea in a video shared on her Instagram page on Thursday evening. Ngozi, who was seen lying on a hospital bed, stated that she urgently needs N30 million for three life-saving surgeries.
